*5/5 Stars - Exceptional Family Holiday with Urvi Tours!*

We recently returned from an unforgettable 11-night family holiday to Iceland with Urvi Tours, and I must say it was truly a trip of a lifetime! The overall rating of 5/5 is well-deserved, thanks to the exceptional service provided by the tour company.

Our tour leader, Nayan Soni, was outstanding - his knowledge and expertise in Iceland are unparalleled. He ensured that every moment of our trip was memorable, from the breathtaking landscapes to the thrilling experiences.

The food was excellent, and we were pleasantly surprised by the picnic lunches, which were often better than regular lunches provided by other tour companies. The Kolkata pan was a lovely touch!

One of the highlights of our trip was witnessing the breathtaking Northern Lights, which we were fortunate to see four times. Initially, we were worried that we might miss this natural wonder, but Nayan ensured that we made the most of our time in Iceland.

In terms of value for money, this tour exceeded our expectations. The attention to detail, the quality of services, and the unforgettable experiences made every penny worthwhile.

I highly recommend Urvi Tours to anyone planning a trip to Iceland or any other destination. Their exceptional service, knowledgeable tour leaders, and commitment to excellence make them a top-notch tour company.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely Horrible Experience with Konduskar Travels – Never Again

I had the misfortune of booking an 11 PM bus with Konduskar Travels (Kolhapur) on 25th May 2025 and what followed was nothing short of a nightmare.

To start with, the bus was 25 minutes late and instead of an apology, the staff yelled at passengers, treating us like cattle being herded into a truck. The bus itself was in an appalling condition —old, dirty, and clearly neglected. The AC vent wasn’t rotating, temperature control didn’t work, and the curtains and pillows were filthy. Worse, due to the rain, water was leaking from the ceiling, and when I raised a concern, I was told to "adjust" because they “don’t keep the bus in good condition anyway.” Completely unacceptable.

The conductor was apathetic offering no real assistance. When I called their office to seek help or a refund, the staff were extremely rude and mocking, even suggesting I go sit at the back of the bus instead. I was ignored when I asked for a refund, and was told to "deal with it."

Throughout the night, the bus kept making unnecessary stops to pick up offline passengers, leading to drunk, unknown men boarding and causing chaos, which made the journey extremely unsafe—especially for women. The final insult? Around dawn, in the middle of heavy rain, the driver stopped for 30 minutes to wash the bus—yes, in the rain. Completely illogical and infuriating.

The bus that was supposed to reach at 6 AM finally arrived at 10:30 AM causing me to miss an important work commitment scheduled at 9:30 AM. This was not just an inconvenience—it a day wasted, a work opportunity missed, and a deeply frustrating, stressful experience.

Konduskar Travels should be held accountable for operating under such poor standards, and treating paying customers with such disrespect and neglect. If you care about your time, safety, or sanity, I highly recommend you avoid this service at all costs. This bus service run by a business person is just for looting the customers !!!

I have done my Narmada Parikrama (NP) with Prabhu Travells (PT) from 21st Feb 2026 to 8th March 2026. I had heared a lot about PT but had never experienced it before.

They have conducted more than 50 batches of NP so they know each and every nook and corner of it's route. Their experience and expertise in this route is very important as route passes through many underdeveloped and backward area. Enroute there are many temptions and confusing roads to shorten the distance which can break your parikrama however with PT's expertise they run you through the right route and ensure that proper NP is completed.
The customers are treated here as hindu religious Parikramavasi without any business touch.
Their USP is, delicious and neutricious food cooked by their own staff, Road travelling only during day time, timely bed tea, branded packaged drinking water, parikrama starting and ending rituals as per our religion etc.
It's not only value for money, I would say it's Double value for your money.
All the best to Prabhu Travels for their future.
- Vijay Raul

featured_reviews.name: meena adurty
featured_reviews.review_text:
Assam, Meghalaya & Arunachal Pradesh with Prabhu Travels Mumbai (11N/12D) 2nd April  to 13th April
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (5/5)
We recently completed an unforgettable 11-night/12-days Budget tour of Assam, Meghalaya, and Arunachal Pradesh, beautifully arranged by Prabhu Travels Mumbai, and I must say — it was one of the most seamless and enriching travel experiences we've had!
Planning & Coordination:
From the very beginning, Prabhu Travels was highly responsive and attentive to our preferences. They curated a well-paced itinerary that gave us a perfect blend of nature, culture, history, and adventure. Communication was smooth, and all our queries were promptly answered, which gave us a lot of confidence before the trip began
•	Destinations Covered:
•	Assam: We started our journey in Guwahati with a visit to the famous Kamakhya  Temple.
•	 Kaziranga National park  is famous for its population of one-horned rhinoceroses—the highest in the world..
•	Arunachal Pradesh: This was the crown jewel of the trip! We visited Dirang, Tawang, and had the surreal experience of visiting Bumla Pass, right at the Indo-China border — a moment we’ll never forget. We also explored the beautiful Tawang Monastery, Sela Pass, Jung water fall  and Jaswant Singh War Memorial /Temple,
•	Bumla Pass Permit was perfectly arranged in advance, so we didn’t have to worry about any paperwork or delays. The snow-covered landscapes and meeting Indian Army personnel at the border was truly a once-in-a-lifetime experience
•	Meghalaya: Cherrapunjee, Shillong, and Dawki were absolutely stunning and the living root bridges in Mawlynnong were true highlights
•	Indo-Bangla Border (Dawki area): We even got a chance to see the friendly Indo-Bangladesh border in Dawki, with local boat rides and a clear view of the neighboring country — quite a unique sight!
All hotels were clean, comfortable, and well-located. The vehicle provided was well-maintained
Highly recommend this  Prabhu travels  organizer  for anyone looking to explore Northeast India in depth. It’s not an easy region to plan on your own due to remote locations and permits, but with the right people handling logistics, it becomes a smooth and soul-filling journey
Thank you once again to Prabhu Travels for an amazing adventure! 🌄🛶🛕🌿

featured_reviews.name: Manasi Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Thank you Nishnai team, Aniket, Praveen, Sanika, Babubhai, & Pallavi for giving us the opportunity to visit and explore Rajasthan - Jodhpur and Jaisalmer and making our tour successful.  This was my 2nd trip with Nishnai Holidays.  The tour started with travelling via Suryanagari Express on 5 March 2026.   I joined the tour as a solo traveler but met a group of friendly people.  Everyone seemed energetic and excited about tour; had been making reels, playing antakshari, dancing on Music.  At Jodhpur, we visited Mehrangarh Fort, Museum, other places, and explored local market best known for handcrafts.   The guides provided us the facts, the historical information about the places.  At Jaisalmer, we visited Sonar fort, Patwon ki Haveli and explored many antique things including utensils, gramophone, telephone, furniture, kerosene fridge, etc.  We visited Bada Bagh, and kuldhara village and learned the history behind its curse.  We enjoyed sam dunes, tent stay, camel ride, Rajasthani cultural program, music, and dinner.   The meals were good along with chaas and desserts.  All hotel rooms were clean, spacious, and royal with good water supply and geyser and AC facility.   Transport AC bus was excellent. I enjoyed the tour and Womens Day celebration with cake, games, reels, and lots of fun.
💯 Value for money.
💯 recommended

Dear Nishnai Group,

I would like to express my sincere gratitude and appreciation for the wonderful pilgrimage tour to Gangapur, Akalkot, Tuljapur, and Pandharpur. The entire journey was a truly enriching and memorable experience, and I am thankful to your team for organizing it so efficiently.

From the very beginning, everything was planned and executed with great care and professionalism. I would especially like to appreciate Ms. Rudra and Mr. Aniket, who were exceptional tour managers throughout the trip. Managing a group of people with different ages, expectations, and personalities is never an easy task, yet they handled every situation with remarkable patience, dedication, and a positive attitude. Their ability to coordinate the group, maintain discipline, and ensure that everyone felt included and comfortable deserves special recognition.

One of the most impressive aspects of the tour was the punctuality and adherence to the schedule. Despite covering multiple destinations, the timings were managed perfectly, allowing us to make the most of our pilgrimage without feeling rushed or exhausted. Such disciplined execution reflects the experience and commitment of your team.

The arrangements for food were also excellent. The meals were timely, hygienic, and well-suited to the needs of the travelers. It is often the small details that make a journey comfortable, and your team ensured that every such detail was taken care of. The transportation, accommodation, and overall logistics were equally commendable and contributed significantly to the pleasant experience.

Beyond the arrangements, what truly stood out was the warmth, care, and personal attention shown by the tour managers and support staff. Their willingness to help, guide, and assist participants at every step created a sense of comfort and trust among the group members. Such dedication transforms a tour from being merely a journey into a memorable experience.

This pilgrimage provided not only spiritual fulfillment but also the opportunity to travel in a well-organized, friendly, and harmonious environment. I returned home with wonderful memories, a sense of peace, and immense appreciation for the efforts put in by the entire Nishnai team.

Please convey my heartfelt thanks to Ms. Rudra, Mr. Aniket, and everyone involved in making this tour such a grand success. I wish Nishnai Group continued success in organizing many more memorable journeys, and I look forward to joining your future tours.

With sincere gratitude and best wishes,

Archana Rane

featured_reviews.name: Akash Raut
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely Disappointing and Unsafe Journey Experience

If safety means nothing to this travel agency, passengers should think twice before booking! Wish I could give zero ratings.

This was one of the worst travel experiences I’ve ever had. The bus dropped me around 70 km before my actual destination (Washim) — in the middle of the highway, with no street lights, no autos, and absolutely no transport facilities around. Even the nearest toll plaza was about 7 km away!

To make matters worse, the driver and cleaner were completely reluctant and careless. They showed no concern or responsibility when passengers questioned them about the wrong dropping point. Such attitude and negligence are totally unacceptable.

This is not just irresponsible — it’s completely unsafe and dangerous. How can a travel agency leave passengers stranded in such a dark and unsafe location at night? It clearly shows zero concern for passenger safety and comfort.

Adding to the disappointment, the ticket price was higher than other travel agencies, yet those agencies ensure drop-off inside Washim city. Why should anyone pay more for such a terrible and unsafe service?

If you cannot provide a proper drop point, then don’t take passengers for that route at all. This is a complete failure of management and coordination. I demand immediate action against the responsible staff and expect the agency to ensure that no passenger has to face such a situation again.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Safety & Security: There were no CCTV cameras. During the dinner break, the staff left the doors wide open and unattended, inviting anyone to walk in. My Crocs were stolen during the trip, and when I confronted the driver and cleaner, they were incredibly rude and dismissive.

Hygiene: The blankets and pillows provided were filthy and clearly hadn't been washed in a long time.

Driver Misconduct: The driver was smoking while driving on the Solapur-Pune highway, which is not only illegal but dangerous and suffocating for passengers.

Utterly unprofessional and unsafe. Save your money and your sanity—book elsewhere.

featured_reviews.name: Bharat Rathod
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would give zero stars if I could. My recent experience with Dolphin Travels was a complete nightmare from start to finish. If you value your time, your safety, or your sanity, do not book a seat with this company.

Arrogant and Rude Staff, The drivers and cleaners behave as if they are doing you a massive favor by letting you on the bus. Any polite question regarding the route or timing is met with shouting or sheer arrogance. They have zero sense of customer service.

Luggage Overloaded, Passengers Ignored, It’s clear this isn't a passenger bus; it's a cargo truck in disguise. The "scheduled" stops are dictated entirely by where they need to load and unload heavy commercial luggage. We sat idle at random points for 45 minutes just to facilitate their side-business of hauling freight.

Absurd Dinner Timings, Don’t bother waiting for the dinner break. They scheduled our "dinner" stop for 12:30 AM. Expecting passengers—including families and the elderly—to eat a heavy meal after midnight just because it suits the driver’s logistics is beyond ridiculous.

Total Disregard for Time, Because of the constant stops for luggage loading, the bus ran hours behind schedule. They prioritize boxes over people every single time.

This company is unprofessional and mismanaged. There are plenty of other operators who actually respect their passengers like IntrCity SmartBus, ZingBus, SaiPooja etc
